title: Last Train Home
logline: Two strangers share a rain-soaked platform when the midnight express is delayed.
plot: Mira waits under a flickering platform light with her guitar case. Jonas arrives breathless, checking a pocket watch. They trade wary glances until distant thunder rolls. Mira offers shelter under her umbrella. Jonas admits he missed the last connection to see someone who may not wait. When the train finally arrives, they choose different doors, but Mira leaves a ticket stub on the bench.
